title: Chronicle Cryptogram
shortDescription: Daily 1920s newspaper cryptograms. Break the cipher offline after packing a field copy.
fullDescription:
The morning edition is on the stands. Chronicle Cryptogram is a vintage newspaper cryptogram: a substitution cipher printed like a 1920s broadsheet, with a serialized case file for solvers who stay on the beat.

Decode the daily Morning Edition and Night Extra. Map symbols to letters, pull the handbook when you stall, and race the clock without giving the game away. Sign in with Google to sync progress and post times on the global codebreaker leaderboard.

Pack a field copy from Bureau File to keep decoding when the wire is down. The cipher, archive, and case file ship with the paper; sign-in and the bureau board stay online.

Features
• Fresh morning and evening ciphers
• Archive of past editions
• In-board glyph tally and primer coaching
• Serialized case files as you solve
• Optional offline press pack from Bureau File
• Optional Google sign-in and cloud progress
• Optional Morning Dispatch at 8:00 a.m. Eastern

The game is free. No ads. No in-app purchases.

Privacy policy: https://jdial1.github.io/Chronicle-Cryptogram/privacy.html
